overview.revision_of: unify.md and unify.json of 2026-10-10, after critic-simplicity.md (CS1 to CS17) and critic-migration.md (CM1 to CM19)
overview.owner_request: Let's try to start organizing things to unify aizk into mb memory, so all runs from the same ducklake + pg system. (owner, 2026-10-10)

inherits: one center PostgreSQL cluster on the internal disk, run by mainboard from the workspace environment, never a system install (Q01)
database mainboard with schema control and one ducklake_<LakeId> schema per lake; Parquet and blobs under the lake DATA_PATH on /Volumes/PORTABLE

overview.goal: AIZK keeps its public identity (its own repository, the five MCP tools, Logto login) but runs on the same system as mainboard: the center's single PostgreSQL cluster holds the DuckLake catalog, mainboard's control schema and AIZK's transactional data in three databases; AIZK's usage history reaches the same DuckLake the evidence lives in; one `mb memory` front, one doctor and one backup chain cover it. It gets there with one build for the center and one night. Nothing is deployed to crimson beforehand, crimson's stack stays stopped and untouched as the revert target, the vector, lexical and model changes are judged offline on scratch restores before the night, and a verified off-host backup comes first because it is worth having even if nothing else happens. crimson's GPU 0 returns for non-exclusive work about a week after the night, 2026-11-25 at the earliest, not before the deadlines.
overview.recommended_layout: One cluster, three databases (mainboard, aizk, logto), roles that cannot cross databases, extensions limited to contrib plus pgvector 0.8.6 (a plain dependency in mainboard.toml), PGDATA on the internal disk, preferably on a reserved APFS volume, daily restore-tested dumps offsite.
overview.recommended_placement: The center Mac mini hosts the cluster and AIZK's whole application tier as native launchd units from a separately locked memory environment; cloudflared is a pinned release binary and Logto runs from its tarball under the environment's Node, with a container only if the Logto spike fails. Embeddings and reranking move to OpenRouter behind the ladder. crimson keeps the old stack stopped and untouched for rollback.
key_evidence: round trip center to crimson over ssh through the cvlab jump: p50 11.5 to 12.0 ms, p99 about 100 ms; bulk 10.8 to 14 MB/s (measured 2026-10-10); find is 8 to 10 SQL statements, p50 4,954 ms; keep p50 280 ms
the data volume of the center has 19 GiB free at 96% (checked 2026-10-11 00:15 JST), down from 28 GiB and from 140 to 156 GiB on 2026-10-06

the live stack is the August 8 lineage (alembic 0012, OIDC proxy auth, fastmcp 3.4.4, critic-measured); HEAD is 23 commits later with migrations 0013 to 0016 (verified) and a RemoteAuthProvider naming Logto (verified)
11 nightly dumps of 1.07 to 1.10 GB exist on crimson and have never been restored; logto, roles, .env and MCP state have no copy (critic-measured)
the center has FileVault on, no auto-login, autorestart 1, a user LaunchAgent as settler and no LaunchDaemons of its own (verified)
the worker holds 5.6 GiB with an 8.5 GiB peak (critic-measured); the code builds a networkx Louvain graph and reads whole embedding tables (verified)

open_questions.question: The unattended center, for AIZK and for the mainboard design: FileVault is on, there is no auto-login and the services are user LaunchAgents, so a power cut or OS restart leaves PostgreSQL, the settler and AIZK down until someone unlocks the console.
